note: The roads only a computer has: the computer's own app scripting, a synced folder, the signed-in Agentlas browser. DECLARED facts with a source (G-1: `facts` are the facts the web placement rules read, and the road's runsOn must equal what they give; the web generator reads `paths` of a copy of this file and refuses a mismatch). READY is never declared here: electron/connectors/desktop-paths.ts reports a road only after measuring it (G-5). `identity` lists the web hosts of a service (a fact of the service, used to find which service a web address belongs to: G-3 applies, no public suffix, no host of ours); it is read by this computer only until the server's own cards list the hosts. A road id is `<server card id>/<short>`; the server drops an id its card set does not have. No road is declared for the screen (computer use): a call to an app by screen has no service identity, so it is not enforced.
